title: Canonical comparison of tensor and ordinary module pullback
statement: For any morphism $g:X\to Y$ of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $g^*_{tensor}$ be tensor-formula module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Define its natural isomorphism with ordinary module pullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to the same module pushforward, using the specified tensor adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For a quasi-coherent module $F$ [pqf-def-coherent], transport the ordinary-pullback quasi-coherence property [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-quasi-coherent] along this comparison to equip $g^*_{tensor}F$ with its quasi-coherence instance. The comparison uses the given adjunction units and no arbitrary isomorphism.
